# rva = Ghidra address - 0x400000. class = owner (MT class or any namespace; empty = global). signature: C++ type, with
# the calling convention when it is not __thiscall (check the `ret N`: CommonLibRE5/CLAUDE.md). Virtual functions are
# named by slot in VFuncs.tsv instead (every override gets the name); a line here overrides that.
